Synchronized AML K=1 independent acceptance pass rates. The AML-shaped synthetic acceptance
experiment to assess the declared condition target contrasts CM with CTL. (A) Expression
feature count 100. (B) Expression feature count 1,000. (C) Expression feature count 10,000.
Black points show the fraction of all requested replicates passing every prespecified AML
criterion; the red horizontal line marks the prespecified 90% cell pass-rate criterion. The
analysis unit is complete synthetic mouse trajectory; the estimand is the replicate pass
fraction within each subjects-per-condition and feature-count cell; time is recorded as
collection time in weeks; adjustment uses batch. Cell acceptance also requires a Wilson 95%
lower bound of at least 80%. Stage 2 must be correctly reported as inapplicable to longitudinal
sampling in every replicate; the required cell rate is 100%. Values are fabricated solely to
demonstrate the figure structure and do not support a scientific acceptance claim.
